solutions.title: Inorder list
solutions.strategy: Materialize the inorder traversal and return the node after p.

timeComplexity.explanation: The traversal can visit every node.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The inorder list stores every node.

solutions.title: BST walk
solutions.strategy: Use BST ordering to track the lowest ancestor larger than p.

timeComplexity.explanation: Only one root-to-leaf search path is followed.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The iterative walk stores a candidate pointer.
